text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Three separate body paragraphs on cost, carelessness, and faulty machines","quality":"development","description":"The essay gives more fully developed reasons with multiple points explained in detail rather than just briefly stated."},{"evidence":"\"However, this would not change the fact...\" and \"Although I believe...\"","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges possible objections and then responds to them instead of only presenting one side."},{"evidence":"\"The author states that...\" and \"To bring in a point from the author...\"","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay uses more direct evidence from the source article to back up its claims."},{"evidence":"\"In conclusion... because they are extremely costly, and can still raise some risks\"","quality":"conclusion","description":"The essay ends with a more explicit wrap-up that restates the position and summarizes the main reasons."},{"evidence":"\"Wouldn't this mean that drivers... would be at risk of crashing?\"","quality":"reasoning","description":"The essay more often explains how its evidence leads to its claims through cause-and-effect logic and rhetorical questioning."}]}
